title: Client Site Brief
description: Template for rebranding the Icon Auto Repair website for a new client

businessName.description: Full business name (e.g., 'Nick’s Auto Service & Tire'). Used in titles, headers, footer.

city.description: City name. MUST be specific to avoid shipping the wrong site. (e.g., 'Plymouth')

state.description: State abbreviation (e.g., 'MI', 'OH', 'PA'). REQUIRED to prevent duplication errors.

address.description: Full street address (e.g., '123 Main St, Plymouth, MI 48170')

domain.description: Vercel domain or subdomain (e.g., 'nicks-auto-service.vercel.app'). Must be unique.

logoUrl.description: Public URL to the business logo image (e.g., via imgbb or postimg). 200x200px or larger.

services.description: List of services THIS business offers. Per-client only — not shared across sites. This client's service list is stored in vault, not reused elsewhere.

description.description: Short meta description (60–160 chars) for SEO. Used in <meta name="description">

primaryColor.description: Primary brand color for THIS business only, as hex code (e.g., '#c8202f'). Each site has its own fixed colors. Dharma Esthetic Design's colors stay until you explicitly change them; same for AI Business Empire. This color applies to this client's site only.

secondaryColor.description: Secondary brand color for THIS business only, as hex code (e.g., '#97121e'). Per-client, not shared.

hours.description: Business hours for THIS client only. Per-client, stored in vault. Each business has its own hours; they do not carry to other sites.

reviewCount.description: Number of Google reviews. Defaults to 38.

templateUrl.description: URL to the Vercel-deployed template site (e.g., 'https://icon-auto-repair.vercel.app'). Defaults to Icon Auto.

example.description: Full-service tire shop and auto repair in Plymouth, MI. Tire sales, brakes, batteries, oil changes, and more.
